end.parentNote: Asha practised naming small animals in soil and leaf litter, including earthworms and ants. Pihu connected ants with places under leaves and shared concerns about touching crawling animals. The mix-up that earthworms are insects was still present at the end. At home, look at a picture or observe safely from a distance and sort animals into “insect” and “not an insect.”
